headline: Patriots place veteran WR Mack Hollins on IR with calf injury
summary: The Patriots placed veteran wide receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday with a calf injury.

headline: Roster Analysis: Patriots place Mack Hollins and Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve in a flurry of roster moves ahead of Sunday's game vs. the Raiders
summary: Special-teams ace Brenden Schooler and CB Kindle Vildor were added to the 53-man roster.

headline: Patriots Activate S Brenden Schooler to the 53-Man Roster; Place FB Reggie Gilliam and WR Mack Hollins on Injured Reserve; Make Additional Roster Moves
summary: The Patriots announced today that S Brenden Schooler has been activated to the 53-man roster. In addition, the Patriots placed FB Reggie Gilliam and WR Mack Hollins on injured reserve and signed CB Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster from the practice squad.

headline: Injury Report Analysis: Patriots rule out six players for Sunday's Week 5 matchup vs. the Raiders
summary: The Patriots will be down six players vs. the Raiders on Sunday, including starting corners Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck).

headline: Patriots won't have starting CBs Christian Gonzalez, Carlton Davis
summary: The Patriots will be without starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis this week.

headline: Patriots to Honor Adam Vinatieri During Halftime Ceremony on Sunday, October 11 Against Raiders
summary: The New England Patriots will celebrate Adam Vinatieri's induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame during a halftime ceremony on Sunday, October 11 against the Las Vegas Raiders.  Ceremony will be streamed live on Patriots.com.
